about: The review of v1's 83 Events when they became files (PLAN M19: every migrated description is checked against a word list of causal and evaluative terms and by Codex, and any that fails is listed for Alex with a proposed neutral rewording, not silently changed). v1 has titles only, so the titles were reviewed. A record of that one review: it is not edited when an Event's wording is later decided. Each Event listed here was written as a draft with its words unchanged; docs/v2/events-review.md is this file as a page.

reviewers.word list: atlas/content/wordlist.py, version 1: a literal match of a closed list
reviewers.Codex: codex exec, read-only, given all 83 titles and asked which are causal, evaluative or otherwise not a plain statement of what happened

events.title: Dot-com bubble peaks (Nasdaq top, Mar 10)
events.codex: 'Bubble' characterizes valuations; 'top' can be stated as an observed peak.

events.title: Bush v. Gore disputed election
events.codex: Conflates a court case with the election; 'disputed' itself is factual rather than evaluative.
events.codex_note: Bush v. Gore is acceptable as the court case's name when referring to that case.

events.title: US recession begins (dot-com bust)
events.codex: 'Bust' is market colour; the parenthetical suggests an explanation for the recession.

events.title: WorldCom collapse; Sarbanes-Oxley signed
events.codex: 'Collapse' is imprecise and dramatic; the title bundles separate events.
events.proposed: Separate Events: "WorldCom files for bankruptcy"; "Sarbanes-Oxley signed"
events.codex_note: Sarbanes-Oxley is an acceptable conventional name for the Act.

events.title: Subprime crisis: BNP freezes funds, credit seizes
events.codex: 'Credit seizes' is a dramatic metaphor; 'crisis' supplies an interpretive frame.
events.proposed: BNP freezes funds; credit availability decreases

events.title: Bear Stearns rescued
events.codex: 'Rescued' frames assistance as a beneficial intervention.

events.title: TARP bank bailout signed
events.codex: 'Bailout' is loaded shorthand for financial assistance.

events.title: Obama elected; Fed launches QE1
events.codex: Bundles two distinct events as a single Event.

events.title: Flash crash; Greek bailout begins euro crisis
events.codex: 'Begins euro crisis' asserts causation; 'bailout' is loaded shorthand, and separate events are bundled.
events.proposed: Separate Events: "Flash crash"; "Greek financial assistance agreed"; "Euro-area financial difficulties begin"
events.keep: "Flash crash" is the conventional name of the 6 May 2010 market event; if kept, accept "crash" for that Event.

events.title: Fukushima disaster; Arab Spring
events.codex: Bundles unrelated events; 'disaster' can be replaced with a more descriptive event category.
events.codex_note: Arab Spring is a conventional historical name.

events.title: Draghi: 'whatever it takes'
events.codex: An attributed quotation is not editorial evaluation, but the title leaves the action implicit.
events.codex_note: 'Whatever it takes' may be retained as an attributed quotation.

events.title: Taper tantrum
events.codex: 'Tantrum' personifies and judges market behaviour; the nickname also embeds an explanatory association.
events.proposed: Market movements during discussion of tapering

events.title: Oil price collapse begins (to 2016)
events.codex: 'Collapse' adds dramatic market colour.

events.title: Greek referendum / bailout crisis
events.codex: 'Bailout crisis' is loaded and vague; the slash leaves the relationship between the subjects unspecified.
events.proposed: Separate Events: "Greek referendum"; "Greek financial assistance difficulties"

events.title: China devalues yuan; global selloff
events.codex: Pairs a policy action with a market movement in a way that suggests causation.
events.proposed: Separate Events: "China devalues yuan"; "Global market selling"

events.title: 'Volmageddon' VIX spike
events.codex: 'Volmageddon' is a sensational nickname; 'spike' adds market colour.

events.title: Q4 selloff; Fed's last hike of cycle
events.codex: Bundles market selling and a rate decision, inviting an explanatory connection.
events.proposed: Separate Events: "Q4 market selling"; "Fed's last rate increase of cycle"

events.title: Yield curve inverts; Fed cuts
events.codex: Bundles distinct financial events in a way that suggests a relationship.
events.proposed: Separate Events: "Yield curve inverts"; "Fed cuts rates"

events.title: COVID-19 pandemic; market crash; CARES Act
events.codex: Bundles three events into an implied explanatory sequence; 'crash' adds market colour.
events.proposed: Separate Events: "COVID-19 pandemic"; "Market prices fall sharply"; "CARES Act"
events.codex_note: CARES Act is an acceptable legislative name.

events.title: George Floyd killed; nationwide protests
events.codex: Combines a killing and protests into an implied causal sequence.

events.title: Jan 6 Capitol attack; GameStop squeeze
events.codex: Bundles unrelated events; 'squeeze' is unexplained market shorthand.
events.proposed: Separate Events: "January 6 Capitol attack"; "GameStop trading squeeze"
events.codex_note: January 6 Capitol attack is a conventional descriptive event name.

events.title: American Rescue Plan ($1.9T)
events.keep: "Rescue" is part of the Act's short title (American Rescue Plan Act of 2021). No rewording proposed: accept the term for this Event (accepted_terms).

events.title: Infrastructure Act; Bitcoin peaks ~$69k
events.codex: Bundles unrelated legislative and market events.

events.title: Inflation Reduction Act; CHIPS Act
events.codex: Bundles two distinct legislative events.
events.codex_note: Both Act names are acceptable; 'Inflation Reduction' is part of a name, not an asserted outcome.

events.title: UK gilt crisis (Truss mini-budget)
events.codex: 'Crisis' is interpretive; the parenthetical implies that the budget explains the gilt-market event.

events.title: FTX collapse; ChatGPT released
events.codex: 'Collapse' is dramatic and imprecise; the title bundles unrelated events.
events.proposed: Separate Events: "FTX files for bankruptcy"; "ChatGPT released"

events.title: Silicon Valley Bank collapse
events.codex: 'Collapse' is dramatic shorthand for a bank failure.
events.proposed: Silicon Valley Bank closed by regulators

events.title: Bank of Japan ends negative rates
Yen carry-trade unwind selloff
events.codex: Labels market selling with an explanatory mechanism, implying causation.
events.proposed: Separate Events: "Yen carry-trade positions reduced"; "Market selling"

events.title: Fed's first cut of cycle (50 bp)
Trump inaugurated; DeepSeek AI shock
events.codex: Bundles unrelated events; 'shock' characterizes a reaction without specifying what happened.

events.title: 'Liberation Day' tariffs; market plunge & 90-day pause
events.codex: 'Liberation Day' is a political slogan; 'plunge' adds market colour, and the bundle implies a causal sequence.
events.proposed: Separate Events: "Tariffs announced"; "Market prices fall sharply"; "90-day tariff pause"
events.codex_note: 'Liberation Day' may be retained only as an explicitly attributed name for the announcement.

events.title: One Big Beautiful Bill Act
events.keep: "Beautiful" is part of the Act's short title. No rewording proposed: accept the term for this Event (accepted_terms).

events.title: Longest US government shutdown (43 days)
events.codex: 'Longest' adds a historical superlative; the duration states the event without that ranking.

events.title: Greenland crisis strains NATO ties
events.codex: 'Crisis' is interpretive; 'strains NATO ties' asserts an effect on relationships.
events.proposed: Disagreement over Greenland involving NATO members

events.title: Supreme Court strikes down IEEPA tariffs
Strait of Hormuz disruption; oil spikes
events.codex: 'Spikes' adds market colour; the pairing implies that the disruption caused the price movement.
events.proposed: Separate Events: "Strait of Hormuz disruption"; "Oil prices rise sharply"

events.title: US–Iran preliminary peace deal; Powell's chair term ends
events.codex: Bundles unrelated diplomatic and institutional events.
events.proposed: Separate Events: "US–Iran preliminary peace agreement"; "Powell's chair term ends"
